name: troop-finances
description: Money tracking for a Scouts BSA troop, running on Cloudflare Workers, D1 and R2.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

ADMIN_EMAILS.description: Comma-separated email addresses of the treasurer(s) who can sign in as admins.

EMAIL_FROM.description: Sender address for sign-in codes, on a domain verified in Resend, e.g. "Troop 123 <finance@example.org>".

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Resend API key used to email sign-in codes (resend.com, free tier is plenty).

CODE_PEPPER.description: Any long random string. Keeps stored sign-in code hashes private.
